values.note: Mitchell County: $25 a night per campsite plus a $4 non-refundable processing fee per reservation. Cashless: all payment through MyCountyParks. Read 2026-11-03.

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Mitchell/Park/Cedar-Bridge-Park/Facility/Cedar-Bridge-Park-Campsite-1/Availability ('Fees $25 per night'; 'A $4.00 NON-REFUNDABLE "Processing Fee" will be added to each campsite reservation'; 'Campsites at Cedar Bridge Park are now cashless. All payments and reservations are to be made on this website.'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Booked and paid only on MyCountyParks (cashless); sites may be reserved up to a year ahead. Reservations are non-refundable with one chance to reschedule. No more than 14 days in any 21-day period. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out before 2 pm. The county map marks sites 15, 16 and 18 as seasonal campsites.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Mitchell/Park/Cedar-Bridge-Park/Facility/Cedar-Bridge-Park-Campsite-10/Availability ('Sites may be reserved up to one-year in advance'; '14 day maximum stay'; contract: 'No camping party or camping unit of any kind shall occupy any camp area for more than 14 days out of any 21-day period'; 'All reservations ... are FINAL and NON-REFUNDABLE'; 'Check-in is after 03:00 PM and check-out is before 02:00 PM'; map legend 'Seasonal Campsite' / 'Online registration only campsite'), read 2026-11-03

sites.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Mitchell/Park/Cedar-Bridge-Park ('This park has 19 designated campsites with electrical and water hookups'; county map numbers sites 1-19), read 2026-11-03

values.note: The park page says camping is seasonal 'Early May - mid October'; the site pages say 'Open Mid May thru Mid October' and point to the county's Facebook page for opening and closing dates.

note: Mitchell County Conservation park just west of Osage on Hwy 9, at the Cedar River Greenbelt Trail and the Milton R. Owen Nature Center. One gravel loop on open mowed ground with a playground and shelter; the Cedar River runs past the east side behind a belt of woods, with access for fishing and paddling. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 + $4 fee, 19 water/electric sites, showers, dump. Added 50-amp, flush toilets, drinking water, booking details (MyCountyParks only, cashless, 1 year ahead, 14 nights in 21), season (early/mid May to mid October, two wordings). Waterfront stays not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT (confirms not waterfront): the Cedar River (about 60 m wide at the sites, riverfront-sized) runs past the campground's east side, but on Esri (220 m frame) the eastern pads end 45-50 m from the bank, behind an unbroken belt of tall trees; the county's aerials show the loop in open ground with the woods between it and the river. No site photo shows the water. Not on-water and no view.
PHONE MISSING: Mitchell County Conservation Board office (641) 732-5204 (Tue-Fri 8-4; park supervisor after hours 641-425-8879), from the facility contract on the site pages.
FIT OK: no lengths posted, but the county's aerial photos show fifth wheels and full-size travel trailers on the gravel pads.
SEASONAL SITES: the county map marks sites 15, 16 and 18 as seasonal; 16 of 19 are nightly online sites.
PIN OK: 43.28251,-92.85437 is at the playground inside the loop.
